newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil names pre-qualified bidders for CEG, Riogas.
newsitem.headline: Brazil names pre-qualified bidders for CEG, Riogas.

text.p: The Rio de Janeiro stock exchange clearing house has published a list of companies which have pre-qualified to participate in the privatization auction of state gas firm CEG and piped gas distributor Riogas.

CEG and Riogas will be sold off July 14 in a closed-envelope auction on the Rio stock exchange at a base price for the companies' total share capital of 423 million reais and 141 million reais, respectively.
The state government will sell off voting shares in CEG worth 65.41 percent of total capital and 58.87 percent of voting capital.

Employees will be able to buy 8.18 percent of CEG voting shares at a discount of 30 percent on the minimum price, while the remaining 57.23 percent will be sold at auction with a minimum price of 252.46 million reais ($235.9 million).

The state is also offering voting and preference shares in Riogas worth 75 percent of total capital or 83.6 percent of voting capital and 70.6 percent of preference share capital at a base price of 105.75 million reais ($98.8 million).

Investors will have to present individual offers for both companies and whoever places the highest combined bid for both gas firms will win. The state government expects the auction to achieve a premium of more than 30 percent on the minimum price.
The following Brazilian companies have pre-qualified for the auction:
* Fundo Mutuo de Investimento em Acoes ABN Amro Index Fund.
The following foreign companies have prequalified for the auction:
* Amoco Brasil Energy Invetments Co Ltda
* Amoco Brasil Gas Investments Co Ltd
* British Gas Netherlands Holdings B V
* GDL Sociedade Distribuidora de Gas Natural de Lisboa SA
* Petrogas Empresa de Transporte e Distribuicao de Gas SA
* GDP Gas de Portugal SGPS SA
* Societa Italiana Peril Gas Per Azioni
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
